features.rationale: The event is described as an all-in-one resort, meaning the parties happen at the hotel where dancers stay.
A PRE PARTY is listed on Thursday 13th May before the festival starts.
An AFTER PARTY is listed for Monday 17th.
The programme lists 8 workshops as part of the festival.
A live concert with a band is part of the programme.
A hotel promo code is given for a negotiated hotel rate, without the accommodation being part of the pass.
